rachel: Quick heads up \u2014 planning a 6-week research trip to Cape Town (Jun 15 to Jul 27) to work alongside a partner university. Will this affect my WFH stipend or payroll?

maria (People Ops): @rachel thanks! First q: staying on Redwood payroll and working for Redwood full-time? Any local contracting or payments from the university?

rachel: Staying on Redwood payroll, full-time. University covers a small travel stipend for flights but not salary. No contracts signed on my behalf.

tom (Payroll): Cape Town \u2014 South Africa has specific withholding and social security rules. 6 weeks is usually under the 183-day residency rule, but there are payroll reporting considerations and potential PAYE triggers if local payments exist. Since you said no salary from the uni, lower risk.

priya (Tax): Also confirm whether you'll present at conferences or run training that could be billed separately by the partner. That could change permanent establishment risk. Please don't sign any engagement docs locally.

dan (Benefits): Benefits note: our medical plan covers short international travel for business but extended leaves abroad may affect coverage. For 6 weeks likely OK, but we'll confirm with the insurer.

ben (Manager): Team supportive. Rachel, keep me looped on dates. Happy to write a brief note on the activity if Tax needs it.

maria (People Ops): Action items for @rachel: 1) Fill remote-location form (choose "temporary > 30 days") 2) Add city+address and flight dates 3) Upload any partner stipend docs. We'll start payroll/tax/benefits check. Link: https://go.redwoodinference.com/remote-request

rachel: Form submitted (address: Observatory Road, Cape Town). Dates above. Stipend is travel-only, small reimbursement for flights.

priya (Tax): Thanks. We'll run an SA checklist and aim to advise within 3 business days. Likely outcome: proceed as planned with documentation and expense reimbursement instructions. If insurer or payroll flags appear we'll advise alternatives.

maria (People Ops): Regarding WFH stipend: policy usually pauses recurring stipend for temporary international stays >30 days and reimburses workspace/hotdesk as expense. But we'll confirm final treatment once Tax signs off. Keep receipts for any co-working or local workspace.

hr-bot: Reminder: register any company equipment being taken abroad in AssetTracker and file the temporary export form.

rachel: Got it, thanks all. Will hold off booking accommodation until final confirmation.

maria (People Ops): Marking status: under review. We'll post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
